rationale: The original short thesis is invalidated as INTC has broken decisively above both session VWAP ($65.69) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($65.83), trading at $66.30 past the $66.20 invalidation level. The most recent 1-minute candle shows a strong breakout on expanding volume (1.65M shares vs ~940k prior average), demonstrating clear relative strength despite the weak broader market (SPY -1.44%). Flipping to long captures the intraday squeeze back toward the opening level ($68.36) while risking down to just below the reclaimed VWAP at $65.65.
